title: Untitled 1
excerpt: last thursday i chose to walk a different way home after work.
body:
last thursday i chose to walk a different way
home after work. i'm not sure why.
between uselessly glancing at my phone
and arching back to fight the forever slump
that consumes me, i was caught by
a glimpse in the gradient blue.

angels wings but no angel. like God wanted
me to fill in the blank even though he knows
i'm not religious. or
pointed hands closing around something so
small i couldn't see it from where i was.
the void between the sky dew. a poem i so
despirately wanted to decipher but heat
pushed me forward out of limbo like the sun
was defending its secret.

the next day my usual route led me, across
the field, toward the baby bunnies
i'd watched grow for the past week.
around their burrow were those same
clouds framing a hollow void, once pulsing
with hopping kits. one dead at its mouth.

escaped the clutches. lost its wings.
